info.cls_ename: Master's Program, Department of Automatic Control Engineering

description.describe_ch: 數位信號處理的應用幾乎無所不在，伴隨著這項觀念的思考與技術在廣泛的科技與工程領域。本課程的目的，就是建立學生從事數位信號處理研究所需的數學理論基礎，並透過所指定的電腦程式寫作與模擬，使學生能在理論與實務之中相互印證。
description.describe_eh: The application of digital signal processing exists ubiquitously in many scientific and technological fields. The goal of this course is to help students build up the foundation of mathematical theory in DSP. And the students can also learn how to verify the DSP theory from the assigned computer exercise.

targets.describe_ch: 理解數位化信號擷取以及控制系統之應用。
targets.describe_en: Comprehension about the application of data acquisition and an control system.

targets.describe_ch: 具備整合式開發環境之操作以及軟體測試的能力。
targets.describe_en: Possess the ability about the manipulation of integrated development environment (IDE) and software testing.

textBooks.tpb_book: 1. A. B. Downey, Think DSP: Digital Signal Processing in Python. Sebastopol, CA, USA: O’Reilly Media, 2016.

readings.tpc_book:
1. A. V. Oppenheim and R. W. Schafer, Discrete-Time Signal Processing, 3rd ed. (Pearson Education, Inc., 2009). ISBN: 978-0131988422.
2. Y. D. Lin and A. Diedrich, Methods on the Assessment of Human Baroreflex Function (Frontiers, 2022). ISBN: 978-2-88976-617-8. Website:  https://www.frontiersin.org/research-topics/14692/methods-on-the-assessment-of-human-baroreflex-function.

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
To ensure that this course proceeds in an orderly manner, some rules are formulated for reference:
1. Respect: Show respect towards your classmates, the instructor, and the learning environment. Treat others with kindness and listen attentively when they speak.
2. Punctuality: Be punctual and arrive on time for each class. Late arrivals disrupt the class flow and can be distracting to others.
3. Preparation: Come to class prepared by completing assigned readings, homework, or other required materials. Being prepared enhances your learning experience and enables meaningful participation.
4. Active Participation: Engage actively in class discussions, ask questions, and contribute your thoughts and ideas. Active participation fosters a collaborative learning environment and enriches everyone's understanding.
5. Cell Phone Etiquette: Turn off or put your cell phones on silent mode during class. Excessive use of cell phones can be distracting and disrespectful to the instructor and fellow classmates.
6. Academic Integrity: Maintain high standards of academic integrity. Plagiarism, cheating, or any form of dishonesty is strictly prohibited. Always give credit to the sources when using external materials.
7. Attendance: Regular attendance is essential for your academic success. Be present for all classes, as valuable information and discussions occur during each session. If you need to miss a class, notify the instructor in advance.
8. Note-Taking: Take thorough and organized notes during lectures or discussions. Effective note-taking helps with comprehension, retention, and serves as a valuable resource for studying.
9. Quietness and Focus: Maintain a quiet and focused atmosphere during class. Avoid unnecessary side conversations that may distract others and disrupt the learning environment.
10. Cleanliness: Keep the classroom clean and tidy. Dispose of trash properly and leave the space in the same condition as you found it.
By adhering to these rules, we can create a productive and respectful learning environment where everyone can thrive and maximize their learning potential.
